title: I Didn’t Realize That Work Was My Identity Until I Was Fired
content: Ientered 2025 with substantial momentum; the first manuscript of my Agricultural Research Service (ARS) postdoc was in review, and I was putting the finishing touches on two more. By all accounts, I was thriving professionally, until my momentum carried me straight into the Department of Governmental Efficiency (DOGE) woodchipper and I, alongside thousands of other USDA employees, was abruptly fired. The disruption to my income and sense of financial stability was expected, and though I was eventually reinstated (later opting into the deferred resignation offer made to all federal employees), I was surprised by the identity crisis that ensued from my loss of employment.
